lines.text: About Meenu Balaji- Child & Pediatric Nutritionist
Meenu Balaji is one of India's leading paediatric nutritionists, with over 14 years of experience working with children, teenagers, and families across India and internationally.

Her work spans children with complex feeding challenges, growth and weight concerns, frequent illness, digestive issues, and the everyday nutrition demands of raising children on Indian food in busy households.

Meenu has developed adolescent nutrition programmes implemented with teenage populations in New Zealand, worked with state and national level young athletes, and supported thousands of families across India, the UK, Australia, and Canada through online consultations.

Her approach is grounded in paediatric nutrition science and built entirely around practical implementation, Indian food, school schedules, picky eaters, joint families, and the real constraints parents face every day.
She holds a Masters in Food Science and Nutrition and consults online across India and in person in Chennai.

faqs.question: Why is child nutrition important?
paragraphs: Proper nutrition is essential for a child's growth, development, cognitive function, immunity, and overall health. It sets the foundation for lifelong wellness.

faqs.question: Who is the best child nutritionist in India?
paragraphs: The best child nutritionist in India is one who specialises exclusively in paediatric and adolescent nutrition, builds plans around Indian food, and has deep experience across the full range of childhood nutrition concerns — growth, picky eating, immunity, teen nutrition, and micronutrient deficiencies specific to Indian children.

Meenu Balaji of Pragmatic Nutrition is one of India's most experienced paediatric nutritionists, with over 14 years working with children aged 2 to 18 across India and internationally. She offers online consultations across India and in person in Chennai.

faqs.question: Can a nutritionist help with picky eating in children?
paragraphs: Yes, and picky eating is one of the most common reasons parents consult a child nutritionist. A specialist can identify whether the picky eating is sensory, behavioural, routine-based, or linked to an underlying nutritional gap, and build a gradual, practical strategy to expand what your child will eat without pressure or force.
At Pragmatic Nutrition, picky eating support is built into every child's nutrition plan as a default, using Indian foods your child already knows as the starting point.

faqs.question: My child is underweight, can a nutritionist help?
paragraphs: Yes. Underweight in children can be caused by insufficient caloric intake, poor appetite, picky eating, micronutrient deficiencies, digestive issues, or a combination of these. A paediatric nutritionist assesses the root cause and builds a plan to address it through food — calorie-dense Indian meals, appetite-supporting strategies, and micronutrient correction where needed.

At Pragmatic Nutrition, underweight and growth concerns are among the most frequently addressed issues, and every plan is built around foods the child will actually eat rather than generic high-calorie protocols.

Meenu consults entirely online with families across India, Chennai, Mumbai, Delhi, Bengaluru, Hyderabad, Pune, Coimbatore, and beyond, as well as with Indian families in the UK, Australia, Canada, New Zealand, and Ireland. All programs are delivered online via video consultation and WhatsApp support.

sections.title: ADHD Nutrition for Children & Adolescents

lines.text: Many parents and adults come to us frustrated after trying multiple diets, supplements, or elimination strategies, only to find that attention, mood, or digestive issues persist. The problem is rarely lack of discipline, it’s lack of root-cause understanding.

At Pragmatic Nutrition, ADHD-focused nutrition is not about rigid meal plans or temporary hacks. It’s about understanding why the body and brain respond the way they do, and building practical, repeatable strategies that fit real life, including school schedules, work routines, and social environments.
Nutrition impacts several biological pathways relevant to ADHD, including:
Neurotransmitter function and brain energy metabolism
Blood sugar regulation and energy stability
Exposure to food additives and ultra-processed foods
Research shows that diet quality, nutrient adequacy, and eating patterns can influence behaviour, attention span, and emotional regulation in children.
The gut and brain are closely connected through the gut–brain axis. Many children with ADHD experience digestive concerns such as bloating, constipation, or irregular appetite.
Reducing dietary triggers that may affect gut comfort and behaviour

Children and teens with ADHD often face:

faqs.question: Can a nutritionist help manage type 2 diabetes?
paragraphs: Yes. Personalised nutrition can be an important part of type 2 diabetes management. A nutritionist can help you understand how your food choices, meal timing, portions, activity and lifestyle may affect your blood glucose, while creating a practical eating plan around your individual needs. Nutrition support works alongside medical care and prescribed treatment.

faqs.question: Can I eat rice if I have diabetes?
paragraphs: Yes. Having diabetes does not automatically mean you need to eliminate rice. The appropriate portion, type of rice, what you eat with it, meal composition, timing and your individual glucose response all matter. Your diabetes nutrition plan can help you include familiar Indian foods such as rice while making the overall meal more glucose-conscious.

faqs.question: Can I get an Indian diet plan for diabetes?
paragraphs: Yes. Your nutrition plan can be built around the foods you actually eat, including rice, roti, dosa, idli, sambar, vegetables, dal, curd, eggs, fish, chicken, snacks and eating-out situations. Rather than giving you a generic diabetes diet chart, the goal is to create a personalised Indian meal plan that fits your lifestyle, preferences and nutritional needs.

faqs.question: Can nutrition help manage diabetes along with medicines?
paragraphs: Yes. Nutrition support works alongside prescribed medical care to help improve blood sugar response and metabolic balance. Our clients notice good changes in HbA1C and overall blood sugar levels in a few months.

faqs.question: Do you work with prediabetes?
paragraphs: Yes. Nutrition support can be useful at the prediabetes stage, particularly when the goal is to improve eating patterns, physical activity, weight management and other lifestyle factors that influence future diabetes risk. Early nutrition and lifestyle changes can be an important part of reducing progression to type 2 diabetes.

faqs.question: Where can I get customized diabetes diet plans in Chennai?
paragraphs: Customized diabetes diet plans in Chennai are usually offered by clinical nutritionists or dietitians with experience in blood sugar management. These plans are personalized based on blood glucose patterns, medications, lifestyle, food preferences, and cultural eating habits. Effective diabetes nutrition focuses on glycemic control, meal timing, carbohydrate quality, fibre intake, and long-term sustainability rather than restrictive dieting.

faqs.question: What are the benefits of personalized nutrition plans for diabetes?
paragraphs: Personalized nutrition plans for diabetes offer clear advantages over generic diet advice because they are built around the individual, not just the diagnosis.

They help improve blood sugar control by aligning meals with a person’s glucose patterns, medications, daily schedule, food preferences, and cultural eating habits. This reduces sharp glucose spikes and crashes, making blood sugar levels more stable over time.

Personalized plans also support sustainable weight management and better insulin sensitivity, which are critical for long-term diabetes control. Instead of restrictive rules, the focus is on realistic food choices that can be followed consistently.

Another key benefit is improved adherence. When a plan fits a person’s lifestyle, work hours, and family eating patterns, they are far more likely to stick with it, reducing reliance on trial-and-error diets.

Finally, personalized nutrition helps lower the risk of diabetes-related complications by addressing cholesterol levels, gut health, inflammation, and nutrient deficiencies alongside blood sugar control, rather than treating glucose in isolation.

faqs.question: Will I need to stop my diabetes medication?
paragraphs: No. You should not stop or change prescribed diabetes medication on your own. Nutrition support works alongside your medical treatment. If your blood glucose changes significantly, discuss any medication adjustments with your doctor or treating healthcare professional.
